You who have opened the door...{WAIT_KEY}
I am Belthasar, the Guru of Reason,
and formerly of the kingdom of Zeal.
I was cast into this era by a great
disaster which befell our land.{WAIT_KEY}
Much to my surprise, I have learned that
the creature Lavos was not a product of
our age—far from it.{WAIT_KEY}
It seems that the being fell from the
sky in a bygone age, burrowing deep into
the planet's core. There he began to feed
upon its energy, growing ever stronger.

Lavos's form was revealed briefly when he
was summoned forth by a mighty wizard by
the name of {MAGUS} in the year 600.{WAIT_KEY}
In the year 1999, Lavos emerged to claim
the surface.{WAIT_KEY}
Now he has taken the place I've named Death
Peak as his throne—or nest, as it may well be.
His miniature spawn now flow from the mountaintop,
an avalanche of death.{WAIT_KEY}
Lavos is a parasite—a parasite of gargantuan
proportions whose host is the planet itself.

Trapped here, I endeavor to continue my study and
observation of Lavos. But I believe the end draws
near.{WAIT_KEY}
Maintaining one's sanity is an endeavor in and of
itself in an age such as this—an endeavor I fear
may be futile.{WAIT_KEY}
So before my mind is lost forever, I have decided to
leave these records of my knowledge behind, along
with my greatest invention.

Ever did I long to return home, and toil endlessly
in search of a way. But as I neared the completion
of my research, so did I near the end of my days.{WAIT_KEY}
I have grown old, and frail. And so I leave it in
your hands—you, who have opened the way.{WAIT_KEY}
Take hold the reins of time, and let all the people
of this planet's past and future join as one!
Then—only then—you just may be able
to stop Lavos.

You have little chance of success.
But even a little chance is still a chance! 
You who have opened the door...the fate
of the world is in your hands.{WAIT_KEY}
Open now the final door, and claim what awaits you.
My last and greatest work...{WAIT_KEY}
The Wings of Time.
